title: Something You Overheard
description: You're in a public place—a café, a train, a waiting room—when fragments of conversation drift into your ears. Something someone says sparks an idea you've never had before. Or reveals a truth you weren't meant to hear.

choices.label: Lean in and listen more carefully

outcomes.narration: You catch more of the conversation. Two strangers discussing an opportunity, a book, a way of thinking. The details click into place with something inside you. When you get home, you look it up. This could change everything—or nothing. But at least now you know.

You put in your earbuds, open a book, look at your phone. Whatever they're discussing is none of your business, and the world has enough eavesdroppers. You feel a quiet satisfaction in respecting boundaries—even your own.
The idea won't leave you alone. You look into it, follow the threads, ask questions. Weeks later, you've begun something—a project, a change, a new path. It started with strangers on a train.

You get excited about the idea but don't know where to start. The momentum fades before you do anything with it. The opportunity slips away—but maybe another will come. The seed was planted, even if nothing grew.
